headlines.description: Stanford barely missed out on the College Football Playoff, and Christian McCaffrey almost won the Heisman Trophy.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCaffrey leads Stanford's 45-16 Rose Bowl romp over Iowa

name: Notre Dame Fighting Irish at Ohio State Buckeyes

headlines.description: Ezekiel Elliott ran for 149 yards and matched a Fiesta Bowl record with four touchdowns, sparking No. 7 Ohio State's prolific offense in a 44-28 win over Notre Dame on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fiesta Bowl: Elliott's 4 TDs spur Ohio St. past ND

name: Oklahoma State Cowboys at Ole Miss Rebels

headlines.description: Chad Kelly threw for 302 yards and four touchdowns -- three to Laquon Treadwell -- and No. 12 Mississippi beat No. 16 Oklahoma State 48-20 in the Sugar Bowl on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Treadwell paces Ole Miss in Sugar Bowl blowout

name: Northwestern Wildcats at Tennessee Volunteers

headlines.description: Joshua Dobbs threw for 166 yards and ran for two touchdowns Friday, helping Tennessee cap its best season in eight years with a 45-6 rout of No. 12 Northwestern in the Outback Bowl.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tennessee routs No. 12 Northwestern 45-6 in Outback Bowl

name: Michigan Wolverines at Florida Gators

headlines.description: Jake Rudock threw for 278 yards and three touchdowns and Michigan's defense dominated throughout in a 41-7 victory over Florida on Friday in the Buffalo Wild Wings Citrus Bowl.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rudock helps Michigan trounce Florida in Citrus Bowl

name: Oregon Ducks at TCU Horned Frogs

headlines.description: Bram Kohlhausen's 8-yard touchdown run in the third overtime carried TCU to a wild victory over Oregon as the Horned Frogs stormed back from a 31-0 deficit on Saturday in the Valero Alamo Bowl.
headlines.shortLinkText: Down 31, TCU rallies for 3OT win in Alamo Bowl

name: Penn State Nittany Lions at Georgia Bulldogs

headlines.description: Terry Godwin threw a touchdown pass on a trick play and caught one later, helping Georgia beat Penn State 24-17 in the TaxSlayer Bowl on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Georgia beats Penn State 24-17 in TaxSlayer for 5th straight

name: Kansas State Wildcats at Arkansas Razorbacks

headlines.description: Alex Collins ran for 185 yards and three touchdowns and Arkansas capped its late-season surge with a 45-23 victory over Kansas State on Saturday in the AutoZone Liberty Bowl.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arkansas motors past Kansas State 45-23 in Liberty Bowl

name: West Virginia Mountaineers at Arizona State Sun Devils

headlines.description: Skyler Howard threw for a Cactus Bowl-record 532 yards and hit David Sills on a 15-yard pass for his fifth touchdown with 2:19 left, lifting West Virginia to a wild 43-42 win over Arizona State e
headlines.shortLinkText: West Virginia beats Arizona State 43-42 in Cactus Bowl

name: Alabama Crimson Tide at Clemson Tigers

notes.headline: CFP NATIONAL CHAMPIONSHIP GAME PRES. BY AT&T

headlines.description: No. 2 Alabama won its fourth national title in the past seven seasons by outlasting the dynamic play of Deshaun Watson and No. 1 Clemson in a 45-40 victory Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bama beats Clemson for 4th title in 7 seasons
